title: Proper direct image, base change and projection formula for $E$ and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$
statement:
Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$ and $p\colon X\to Y$ proper between standing schemes.

1. For $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$ bounded below,
   $Rp_*(K[1/\ell])\simeq(Rp_*K)[1/\ell]$; for $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ bounded below and
   $F/E$ finite, $Rp_*(K_F)\simeq(Rp_*K)_F$ and $Rp_*(K_{\Qlb})\simeq(Rp_*K)_{\Qlb}$, via the
   canonical maps.
2. $Rp_*$ maps $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)$.
3. The proper base change and projection formula maps are isomorphisms on $\Dbc(-,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Properness gives finite type and a closed-immersion diagonal, hence qcqs. Finite type over $k$ makes standing schemes Noetherian. The cited coefficient flatness makes extension exact and preserves lower bounds.

Apply the filtered-presentation criterion to $R=\cO_E$, $S=E$, $P_n=R_Y$ with transition $\ell$ and legs $\ell^{-n}$. The coefficient-localization statement supplies this cocone; every stage projection is the tensor-unit identity. For $E\to F$ use the existing finite-extension comparison. For $E\to\Qlb$ use $P_F=F_Y$ over the finite fields containing $E$; directedness makes these cofinal, and the ring colimit is a module colimit. The criterion for the one-object presentation of each $F_Y$ identifies its stage projection with the restricted finite-extension comparison, so every stage is invertible. This proves all of (1).

An integral generator has integral bounded constructible direct image. Part (1), scalar transitivity and preservation of constructibility by extension put its rational image in $\Dbc$. Pushforward is exact and target $\Dbc$ is triangulated, so induction on the finite cones and shifts generating the source proves (2).

In a cartesian square $p'$ is proper. For an integral generator $K_0$, its pullback is integral $\Dbc$. Apply coefficient-exchange mates using the exchange counit identity, coefficient counit identity and monoidal pull-comparison cube. Part (1) inverts both push comparisons; the integral theorem inverts exchange. Hence rational exchange is invertible on generators. For $\cO_E\to E\to\Qlb$, the coefficient cocycle identifies the composite comparison with the direct one. Part (2), pullback preservation and the restricted-adjunction definitions identify these with the $\Dbc$ maps.

For projection use the common-field lemma for a pair of Qlbar generators; E-generators already share $\cO_E$. The integral tensor $H=K_0\otimes^Lp^*M_0$ is bounded constructible. In the coefficient/projection square, part (1) inverts both push comparisons (for $\cO_F\to\Qlb$ through $F$, the coefficient cocycle identifying the direct comparison with the composite, as in step 4) and the integral theorem inverts projection. All pull/tensor comparisons are invertible, so rational projection is invertible on these pairs.

Exchange commutes with shifts by the ambient-normalization lemma; projection does so in both variables by the two ringed projection shift statements. Their isomorphism loci contain zero, are shift-stable and cone-stable by triangle two-out-of-three. Induct on finite generator constructions: once for exchange; for projection first in $K$ with a fixed $M$-generator, then in $M$ with arbitrary $K$. This proves (3) for the specified canonical maps.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q14-dcdd9d92c (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all four new nodes, every cited statement and the main-20261015 rational proof. The re-split is faithful. Of the 11 old steps: old 2 and 4 become the filtered-legs criterion; old 3 is the existing imported lem-sfb-subfield-push-iso; old 6 is covered by the existing push-counit node, the ringed monoidal-comparisons node and det-prop-scalar-six-pullback; old 7 and 10 become the exchange-normalization node plus existing projection-shift nodes; old 8 becomes the common-field node; old 9 becomes the projection-square node; old 5 and 11 stay as assembly steps 3 and 6. The four new nodes are statement-only and of comparable size, none restates a clause of the item, and the proof is 6 steps and 2585 chars. All four statements are true. (A) Bounded continuity via det-pe-bounded-continuity-direct-image, with the leg identity checked on the one-object and ell-tower cases. (B) Compositum F, then generators clause (3) with E:=F, then scalar-pullback clauses (2) and (3). (C) Both composites have matching types; this is the old step-9 transpose calculation. (D) Triangle identity, adjoint shifts, and agreement with det-def-sfb-base-change-morphism-bc. Steps 1-6 and the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-coefficient-exchange-mates are verified; I found no cycle and no duplicate (I opened lem-sfb-qlbar-push-iso-proper, lem-sp-direct-image-change-ring-transpose and the continuity nodes), and no SGA. One fault, fixed: step 5 inverts the direct O_F-to-Qlbar push comparisons by part (1) without citing the coefficient cocycle. I added lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-cocycle to its uses and text; proof_deps is unchanged. Batch 5: lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison is general module-object/ringed-topos infrastructure (Stacks 07A4/07A6/0B56). It is not given by Poincare duality and cannot be replaced by that leaf, and three PASSed sfb nodes already cite it, so I accept it. The trf reach through def-sfb-dc-lower-star, the upper-lower adjunction, integral-models-generators and the base-change-morphism nodes is generic and already in the base item's closure; the closure diff adds no trf node. Accepted. Advisory: the existing lem-sfb-qlbar-push-iso-proper would give E-to-Qlbar directly, but the blueprint continuity route is legitimate.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
